success.description: 16 Power, engaged with target corpse of a living being killed within a day. Special: The spell recharges at dawn.
The target corpse is brought back to life fully healed of wounds and/or diseases. The resurrected causes Fear {Dc} on your enemies, where {Dc} is the number of generated.

sigmarsComet.description: The resurrected can automatically take a turn. The resurrected acquires an Insanity with the trauma trait.
